title: Common definitions
description: Shared types referenced by every Do Zore data schema.

Id.description: Stable machine id: lowercase ASCII snake_case, no diacritics. Never shown to players.

LocalizedText.description: Player-facing text. Serbian (Latin script) is required; English is optional.

Dinars.description: Amount of in-game money (dinari) as a non-negative integer.

Weight.description: Relative weight for weighted random choice. 0 disables the entry.

Amount.description: Money amount that scales with progress: fixed + income_minutes * (current income per minute), then clamped to at least min. At least one of fixed or income_minutes must be present.
